title: Wedding language
context: Something that feels special and elevated, but not through the usual performative markers of fancy. Elevated backyard party. Intimacy, informality, people actually relaxed and present — but with care put in.

title: Wedding day structure and values outline
context: Noémi's theatrical-acts brainstorm — the wedding as a story with acts. Arrival, ceremony, feast, dancing, wind-down. Each act has a mood.

title: Wedding venue planning and cost estimate
context: Babós-Forró Mansion, Pădureni — rural Transylvania, outdoor space. Old stone walls, wild garden, views of the hills. Budget: under €8k total.

title: Elegant Outdoor Wedding Reception Under Decorated Tent
context: String lights, long wooden tables, mixed wildflowers. Casual but beautiful.

title: Outdoor Wedding Reception Under Tent
context: Canvas tent, mismatched chairs, fairy lights. Intimate feeling.

title: Outdoor Wedding Reception in European Village Square
context: Cobblestone, long communal table, candles. Village celebration feel.

title: Outdoor Wedding Reception Under Canvas Tent
context: Draped fabric, lanterns, wooden benches. European countryside.

title: Rustic Wedding Venues in Transylvania
context: Outdoor venues with character — barns, mansions, village squares. Character over luxury.

title: Anti-registry idea: instead of a gift list, ask people to bring a dish from their culture
context: Potluck wedding. Everyone contributes. The food IS the gift. Hungarian, Romanian, Dutch, Iranian dishes on one table.

title: Wedding catering — local vs imported food
context: Preference for local, seasonal, simple food. Nothing fussy. A pig roast, fresh bread, garden salads, local wine. The food should feel like the place.

title: The wedding should feel like a really good dinner party that happens to have a ceremony in the middle
Rustic outdoor table with herbs and candles
context: Simple, abundant, imperfect. Rosemary sprigs as decoration. No centerpiece — just food.
